evidence.r1: Light and dark: filter, search, zoom and vehicle-action bars are glass; alert and vehicle information panels are opaque.
evidence.r2: Light and dark: selected filter and action backgrounds are flat fills within their bars, with no overlapping glass surfaces.
evidence.r3: Light and dark: glass is limited to route, status, search, zoom and the selected-vehicle action group.
evidence.r4: Light and dark: all floating control bars share the same softly frosted appearance.
evidence.r5: Light and dark: no clear-glass treatment is visible on the map controls.
evidence.r6: Light and dark: action fills are neutral, with route colours appearing as identifying dots rather than tinted button backgrounds.
evidence.r7: Light: street detail is softened beneath the top controls and water colour remains visible through the zoom bar.
evidence.r8: Light and dark: filters and zoom are capsules, while information panels use fixed rounded corners.
evidence.r9: Light and dark selected-vehicle views: capsule action fills flare inside a much squarer outer action bar.
evidence.r10: Light and dark: filter and action buttons have capsule ends, with compact search-key hints using rounded rectangles.
evidence.r11: Light and dark: route, status and search form three top groups, and zoom is separately grouped below.
evidence.r12: Light and dark selected-vehicle views: the icon-only close action shares glass with Call operator, Hold and Follow.
evidence.r13: Light and dark: each toolbar has a continuous material surface behind its complete control group.
evidence.r14: Light and dark: related filter items share material and the separate bars retain intentional spacing.
evidence.r15: Light and dark: the map meets floating controls without any visible scroll-edge treatment.
evidence.r16: Light and dark: street grids and bathymetric markings provide varied backdrops behind filters and zoom.
evidence.r17: Light and dark resting views: street-grid content continues directly underneath the top filter and search controls.
evidence.r18: Light and dark: filter labels and search text remain dark-on-pale or light-on-dark with strong readable separation.
evidence.r19: Reduced light: solid controls remain readable, but neither increased contrast nor reduced motion is shown.
evidence.r20: Light and dark: the map reaches all window edges behind the floating controls and inset alert panel.
evidence.r21: Light and dark: the map continues around and behind the inset sidebar, with the network centre clear of top and bottom bars.
evidence.r22: Light and dark selected-vehicle views: the large information platter has an opaque custom-looking sheet background and outline.
evidence.r23: Light and dark selected-vehicle endpoints provide no evidence of morphing or pointer-local press feedback.
evidence.r24: Light and dark: saturated route-identification dots appear inside the top control bar, not solely in map content.
evidence.r25: Light and dark: filter text uses neutral ink rather than matching the coloured route lines beneath it.
